en: Dependent on a state that is the object of clinging (*parāmāsa*), a state that is not the object of clinging arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).

Under root condition there are five; ... [as before] ... under resultant condition there is one; ... [as before] ... under non-disappearance condition there are five. (This is similar to the *āsava* group.)
